model_meta.description: Concept model of the claimed flexible shaft coupling: a rigid tubular hub with an axial bore and substantially circumferential slit transmits rotational force between drive and driven shafts; the hub has convex slit-adjacent ends with arcuately receding outer surfaces.

subsystems.description: External source shaft received at the drive end of the coupling's axial bore; supplies rotational force.

Rigid-material tubular coupling hub with an axial bore and substantially circumferential slit providing flexibility. Slit-adjacent circumferential ends are convex with arcuately receding outer peripheral surfaces.
External receiving shaft attached at the opposite end of the hub and receiving transmitted rotational force.

item_flows.name: Drive-shaft rotational force
item_flows.notes: Rotational force enters the hub from the drive rotation shaft.

item_flows.name: Transmitted rotational force
item_flows.notes: Rotational force exits the hub to the driven rotation shaft.

steps.description: Receive rotational force from the drive rotation shaft through the axial bore at one end of the hub.
Transmit rotational force through the flexible hub to the driven rotation shaft attached at the other end.
